## `adversarial/`

Generated by `node --experimental-strip-types tests/fixtures/generate-adversarial.ts` with the ZIP
writer in `tests/support/zip.ts`: path traversal, absolute and Windows paths, server scripts,
`.htaccess`, duplicate entries, a 64 MB ZIP bomb, forged size headers, missing `content.xml`, legacy
`contentv3.xml`, a non-ZIP file and an XXE attempt. They are inert test data.
